name: Optimization Methods
description: This course covers fundamental and advanced optimization methods, including problem formulation, classification, and algorithm selection. It explores numerical models, derivative computation techniques, and both gradient-based (for example, line search, trust-region, SQP) and gradient-free (for example, genetic algorithms, PSO) optimization methods. Unconstrained optimization techniques such as steepest descent, Newton’s method, and quasi-Newton methods are discussed, along with constrained optimization approaches like penalty methods. Topics also include multi-objective optimization, surrogate modelling (for example, Kriging, deep learning), and optimization under uncertainty using Monte Carlo techniques.
